profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an AI governance company founded in 2020. On its own site it describes itself as the trusted leader in AI governance and says it created the AI governance category, and it now positions that work for what it calls the agentic era. The platform is built to help enterprises discover their AI, enforce policy, manage AI risk, and prove compliance across every agent, application, model, and AI vendor. The company says the platform is powered by a Knowledge Graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with a customer's business context, and that it is supported by forward-deployed governance experts. GAIA, its Govern AI Assistant, is described as generally available in the platform today.

The company says it offers pre-built policy packs with regulatory intelligence for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards, along with automated workflows and audit-ready evidence. It describes agent governance as a focus, with a registry for every agent and purpose-built agentic risk and controls, treating agents as first-class governed entities that are registered, risk-assessed, sanctioned, and governed. Credo AI says its regulatory intelligence is drawn from 300 or more integrations and from standards work at ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD. It is tracked as a product in the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category.

Customers and partners named on the site include Mastercard and IBM. One quoted customer says working with the platform accelerated EU AI Act compliance by at least 10x the speed of doing it manually, and another describes a 100% focus on raising the bar on enterprise AI trust. No litigation involving the company is noted, and no MCP server is listed.
